from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict
from typing import Any

class Inner(BaseModel):
    name: str
    args: dict[str, Any]
    fingerprint: str = ""
    id: str = ""

    def __init__(self, name: str, args: dict[str, Any], **data):
        self._fp = "fp-" + name
        super().__init__(name=name, args=args, fingerprint=data.pop("fingerprint", self._fp), id=data.pop("id", self._fp[:8]), **data)

    def model_post_init(self, ctx):
        if not self.fingerprint:
            object.__setattr__(self, "fingerprint", "post-" + self.name)
            object.__setattr__(self, "id", "post-" + self.name[:8])

# path 1: __init__
a = Inner(name="x", args={"a": 1})
print("init:", a.fingerprint, a.id)

# path 2: model_validate
b = Inner.model_validate({"name": "y", "args": {}})
print("validate:", b.fingerprint, b.id)

from pydantic import TypeAdapter
class Outer(BaseModel):
    inners: list[Inner]

c = TypeAdapter(Outer).validate_python({"inners": [{"name": "z", "args": {}}]})
print("nested:", c.inners[0].fingerprint, c.inners[0].id)

# equality across paths for same data
d1 = Inner(name="x", args={"a": 1})
d2 = Inner.model_validate({"name": "x", "args": {"a": 1}})

    name: str
    fingerprint: str = ""

import hashlib, json
from typing import Any
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, TypeAdapter

def _canonicalize_args(args):
    if isinstance(args, dict):
        return {key: _canonicalize_args(args[key]) for key in sorted(args)}
    if isinstance(args, (list, tuple)):
        return [_canonicalize_args(item) for item in args]
    if isinstance(args, str):
        return args.strip()
    return args

def _compute(name, args):
    canonical = {"name": name, "args": _canonicalize_args(args)}
    serialized = json.dumps(canonical, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
    return hashlib.sha256(serialized.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

class ToolCall(BaseModel):
    name: str
    args: dict[str, Any]
    fingerprint: str = Field(frozen=True)
    id: str = Field(frozen=True)

    def __init__(self, name: str, args: dict[str, Any], **data: Any):
        data.pop("fingerprint", None)
        data.pop("id", None)
        digest = _compute(name, args)
        super().__init__(name=name, args=args, fingerprint=digest, id=digest[:8], **data)

class ToolCalls(BaseModel):
    tool_calls: list[ToolCall]

# basic
tc = ToolCall(name="get_weather", args={"city": "Paris"})
assert len(tc.fingerprint) == 64 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in tc.fingerprint)
assert tc.id == tc.fingerprint[:8] and len(tc.id) == 8
print("basic ok", tc.id)

# key order
assert ToolCall(name="f", args={"a": 1, "b": 2}).fingerprint == ToolCall(name="f", args={"b": 2, "a": 1}).fingerprint
print("key order ok")

# nested key order
assert ToolCall(name="f", args={"x": {"b": 1, "a": 2}}).fingerprint == ToolCall(name="f", args={"x": {"a": 2, "b": 1}}).fingerprint
print("nested order ok")

# whitespace
assert ToolCall(name="f", args={"q": "  hello \n"}).fingerprint == ToolCall(name="f", args={"q": "hello"}).fingerprint
assert ToolCall(name="f", args={"q": "hello"}).fingerprint != ToolCall(name="f", args={"q": "hello world"}).fingerprint
print("whitespace ok")

# tuple -> list
assert ToolCall(name="f", args={"l": (1, 2)}).fingerprint == ToolCall(name="f", args={"l": [1, 2]}).fingerprint
print("tuple ok; stored args:", ToolCall(name="f", args={"l": (1, 2)}).args)

# name included
assert ToolCall(name="f1", args={"a": 1}).fingerprint != ToolCall(name="f2", args={"a": 1}).fingerprint
print("name ok")

# types preserved
assert ToolCall(name="f", args={"x": 1}).fingerprint != ToolCall(name="f", args={"x": "1"}).fingerprint
assert ToolCall(name="f", args={"x": True}).fingerprint != ToolCall(name="f", args={"x": 1}).fingerprint
assert ToolCall(name="f", args={"x": 1}).fingerprint != ToolCall(name="f", args={"x": 1.0}).fingerprint
print("types ok")

# read-only fingerprint
try:
    tc.fingerprint = "x"
    print("FAIL: no raise")
except Exception as e:
    print("frozen fp ok:", type(e).__name__)
# args still mutable
tc.args = {"city": "Rome"}
tc.args["extra"] = 1
print("args mutable ok, fp unchanged:", tc.fingerprint)

# from_dict_list-like + outer model + validate paths
outer1 = ToolCalls(tool_calls=[ToolCall(name="g", args={"a": 1})])
outer2 = ToolCalls.model_validate({"tool_calls": [{"name": "g", "args": {"a": 1}}]})
assert outer1 == outer2
assert outer2.tool_calls[0].fingerprint == outer1.tool_calls[0].fingerprint
ta = TypeAdapter(ToolCalls).validate_python({"tool_calls": [{"name": "g", "args": {}}]})
assert ta.tool_calls[0].fingerprint == ToolCall(name="g", args={}).fingerprint
print("paths ok")

# model_validate with explicit fingerprint in dict (no crash)
v = ToolCall.model_validate({"name": "g", "args": {}, "fingerprint": "BOGUS", "id": "B"})
print("explicit fp handled:", v.fingerprint == _compute("g", {}))

# schema unchanged-ish
schema = ToolCall.model_json_schema()
print("schema props:", sorted(schema["properties"].keys()), "required:", schema.get("required"))

# model_copy
c = tc.model_copy(update={"args": {"z": 9}})
print("model_copy ok, stale fp preserved:", c.fingerprint == tc.fingerprint)

class ToolCall(BaseModel):
        name: str
        args: dict[str, Any]
        fingerprint: str = Field(frozen=True)
        id: str = Field(frozen=True)

        def __init__(self, name: str, args: dict[str, Any], **data: Any):
            """Initialize the ToolCall and compute its deterministic fingerprint.

            The fingerprint is the SHA-256 hex digest of the tool name and the canonicalized args
            (sorted dict keys, tuples converted to lists, trimmed string values). It is computed once at
            creation time and stored read-only for deduplication, caching, and debugging. The `id` is the
            first 8 characters of the fingerprint.
            """
            data.pop("fingerprint", None)
            data.pop("id", None)
            digest = _compute_tool_call_fingerprint(name, args)
            super().__init__(name=name, args=args, fingerprint=digest, id=digest[:8], **data)

    tool_calls: list[ToolCall]

from dspy.adapters.types.tool import ToolCalls, _canonicalize_args, _compute_tool_call_fingerprint
import json, hashlib

TC = ToolCalls.ToolCall

# edge cases
assert TC(name="f", args={}).fingerprint == hashlib.sha256(b'{"args":{},"name":"f"}').hexdigest()
assert TC(name="f", args={"n": None}).fingerprint == hashlib.sha256(b'{"args":{"n":null},"name":"f"}').hexdigest()

# unicode
u1 = TC(name="café", args={"g": " naïve "}).fingerprint
u2 = TC(name="café", args={"g": "naïve"}).fingerprint
assert u1 == u2

# deep nesting with mixed containers
deep1 = {"a": {"b": [(1, 2), {"d": " x", "c": 3.5}, True, None]}}
deep2 = {"a": {"b": [[1, 2], {"c": 3.5, "d": "x"}, 1, None]}}
assert TC(name="f", args=deep1).fingerprint != TC(name="f", args=deep2).fingerprint  # True vs 1 differ
deep3 = {"a": {"b": [[1, 2], {"c": 3.5, "d": "x"}, True, None]}}
assert TC(name="f", args=deep1).fingerprint == TC(name="f", args=deep3).fingerprint

# helper behavior
assert _canonicalize_args({"b": (1, " s "), "a": {"c": [2]}}) == {"a": {"c": [2]}, "b": [1, "s"]}
assert _canonicalize_args(5) == 5
assert _canonicalize_args(True) is True
assert _canonicalize_args(1.5) == 1.5

# json round-trip of a full ToolCalls keeps consistent fingerprints
tc1 = TC(name="t", args={"k": " v "})
dumped = tc1.model_dump_json()
tc2 = TC.model_validate_json(dumped)
assert tc2.fingerprint == tc1.fingerprint and tc2.id == tc1.id
assert tc1 == tc2

# independent of metadata / repeated creation
assert TC(name="t", args={"k": "v"}).fingerprint == tc1.fingerprint

# from_dict_list with nested structures
tcs = ToolCalls.from_dict_list([{"name": "n", "args": {"x": (1, "a ")}}])
assert tcs.tool_calls[0].fingerprint == TC(name="n", args={"x": [1, "a"]}).fingerprint

print("All edge cases passed")
